paper_metadata.title: New Mg-based amorphous alloys in Mg-Y-misch metal systems

evidence.quote: New amorphous alloys in the Mg-Y-Mm (where Mm denotes misch metal) system were found to form in the composition range 2.5-15 at.% Y and 0%-8% Mm by melt spinning.
